description: Lab Report - A document issued by a clinical or diagnostic laboratory summarizing the results of medical tests performed on patient samples. Typically includes the patient's name and date of birth, ordering physician, specimen type and collection date, test names, results, reference ranges, and any abnormal flags. Results may cover bloodwork, urinalysis, pathology, microbiology, or other diagnostic panels. The report is used by clinicians to diagnose conditions, monitor treatment, or assess overall health.
